title: Which mounting-rod dimensions are needed when ordering a carbon-fibre cylinder curing oven?
summary: Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s cylinder rotary-curing oven proposal dated 10 February 2025 assigns the mounting rods at both ends to the buyer and asks for accurate dimensions in advance. A three-jaw chuck grips one rod while a rear support carries the other, so the cylinder, rods and holding mechanism must be assessed together. The proposed Φ500 × 1000 mm workpiece dimensions exclude the rods. Cylinder dimensions alone cannot confirm clamping, rotation or travel into and out of the oven.
